purpose: Research and a bounded M3 validation proposal; not executable provisioning authorization.

recommendation.reason: Owner chose Runpod Pods; M2 measured this exact GPU/model/workflow. Reuse the existing account and preserve separate provisioning/execution contracts.
recommendation.future_backend: Serverless remains unscheduled; this proposal authorizes no endpoint.

approval.provider_preference: Existing owner choice: Runpod GPU, then Pod. Starting M3 does not reset the M2 USD3 cap.

proposed_validation.selection_scope: Unchanged Wan2.1 T2V1.3B, pinned core-node graph and three verified model files; new M3 worker downloads remain within the proposed M3 opt-in scope.
proposed_validation.image_note: # pragma: allowlist secret - public provenance hash
proposed_validation.runner_network: ComfyUI127.0.0.1 via private SSH tunnel; no public ComfyUI/Jupyter port.
cases: One same-shot success with normalized artifact/manifest checks.
One injected post-acquire failure followed by verified owned-worker cleanup; no extra generation required for the failure case.
proposed_validation.cleanup: Download synthetic outputs privately, then terminate only M3 test Pods created by this run. Never terminate the stopped M2 learning Pod or unrelated resources.
preconditions: External programmatic credentials supplied without extracting MCP OAuth.
Re-read SKU/region capacity, rate and image/runtime compatibility immediately before create.
Independent worker shutdown guard and owned-resource recovery are configured; unknown create outcomes cannot blind retry.

unapproved_alternate_gpu.status: Research only; not admitted by the measured4090 model/hardware selection.

comparison.compute_quote: RTX4090 USD0.89/hour from authenticated catalog snapshot.
comparison.regions: Proposed US-IL-1; region-local stock must be re-read.
comparison.storage: Container disk resets on stop. Pod volume survives stop but not termination. Network volume outlives Pods and bills independently; no persistent storage proposed now.
comparison.terms_and_retention: Terms assign content security/backups to customer and grant operation plus aggregated/anonymized improvement rights. Personal-information retention depends on purposes/legal duties; lifecycle deletion is not a zero-retention or forensic-erasure guarantee.
comparison.fit: Chosen: exact M2 measured SKU/workflow and existing owner account; private synthetic validation only.

comparison.compute_quote: Single NVIDIA A10/24GB USD1.29/hour on public pricing page, plus applicable taxes; not a4090 performance or compatibility equivalent.
comparison.regions: Overview lists US, Europe, Middle East and Asia locations; GPU availability varies by region and authenticated capacity was not queried.
comparison.storage: Root volume included by instance type; persistent filesystem attaches at create in same region/workspace and continues billing after instance deletion. No filesystem quote asserted.
comparison.terms_and_retention: Customer owns security/backup obligations. Terms permit deleting customer data after termination but also retaining copies under retention practices; no immediate-erasure guarantee.
comparison.fit: Alternative reviewed, not selected: different unmeasured GPU and new account/provider integration.

comparison.compute_quote: L4 GPU USD0.000222/second (=USD0.7992/hour), plus separate CPU/memory/egress; not a4090 all-in price or compatibility equivalent.
comparison.regions: US/EU/AP broad or narrow selection; region multipliers1.15x broad/1.75x narrow. Default function inputs route through Virginia before execution; container region alone is not a complete residency claim.
comparison.storage: Volumes USD0.09/GiB/month with1TiB included per current pricing; persistent until deleted. New SDK/image/volume lifecycle differs from selected Pod.
comparison.terms_and_retention: Customer-data license limited to service delivery; retention is product-specific: Function inputs/outputs up to7days, Starter app/container logs1day, volume/image files until deleted, snapshots have separate retention.
comparison.fit: Future elastic-workload candidate; switching would change the current Pod workflow and require fresh hardware/provider approval.

data_policy.validation_inputs: Original synthetic paper-boat prompt only; no private characters, likeness, voices, customer files or secrets in workflows.
data_policy.artifacts: Keep primary outputs/journals privately on laptop with checksums before releasing ephemeral workers; no media/model weights in Git or registry.
data_policy.persistent_storage: Deferred per owner; later consider only frequently reused setup/models. No volume creation or private/public image publication in M3.1.
data_policy.retention_limit: Provider terms/account records may outlive a worker. No universal deletion SLA, legal/privacy certification or confidential-production approval is inferred.

credential_boundary.current_agent_control_plane: Hosted Runpod MCP OAuth; research does not consume CLI/API credentials.
credential_boundary.programmatic_worker_adapter: Externally supplied RUNPOD_API_KEY or an explicitly configured supported credential provider; no key requested in chat or committed. MCP OAuth is not automatically a library credential.
credential_boundary.worker: SSH private key remains on laptop; an existing Pod-scoped shutdown credential, if present, stays only inside that worker.
credential_boundary.redaction: No tokens, request authorization headers, credential-bearing URLs or raw API errors in manifests/logs.

completion: M3.1 remains incomplete until owner provider/spend approval, independent current-head review/testing, required CI and coordinator-verified merge. No resources provisioned by this research.
